entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who returns to her home plane Kaladesh against the others' wishes, fueled by grief and rage about her parents.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker who follows Chandra to Kaladesh and encourages her toward revenge.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A gray-haired man with a metallic claw for a right hand and a hidden face, who is Head Judge of the Inventors' Fair and hunts the Renegade Prime.

entities.name: Renegade Prime
entities.description: An older woman with auburn hair, welding goggles and a handheld welder, called the Renegade Prime by Tezzeret; Chandra recognizes her as her mother.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's father, a great inventor depicted in a mosaic, killed by Baral.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A uniformed officer who Chandra says killed her father and led the soldiers who burned her village.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate inspector who sought the Gatewatch's help and whom Chandra calls one of them.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that declined to intervene on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh whose lawkeepers, guards and soldiers hunt renegades.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Outcast inventors working against the Consulate, whose allies recognize a Leaking Spire symbol.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane of aether and inventors.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh where the Inventors' Fair is held.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch decided not to intervene.

entities.name: Ovalchase
entities.description: A venue in Ghirapur from which renegade inventors with automatons hurry away.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The Kaladeshi festival that a disruption threatens and which Tezzeret calls his own.

entities.name: Leaking Spire
entities.description: A symbol that renegade sympathizers hide and recognize.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: Raw potential energy filling Kaladesh's air and powering its airships and pipes.

events.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
events.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

events.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
events.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

events.summary: Liliana appears on the balcony next to Chandra, having followed her.
events.quote: Standing on the formerly unoccupied balcony next to her was Liliana

events.summary: A gray-haired hooded man sneaks through Ghirapur toward the Inventors' Fair, avoiding patrols.
events.quote: A gray-haired man slipped through Ghirapur with a series of sideways moves.

events.summary: Liliana persuades Chandra to celebrate her return while still looking for the renegade.
events.quote: Then I think it's high time we celebrated your grand return to your hometown.

events.summary: The hooded man hides his face and arm in the crowd to complete his mission unnoticed.
events.quote: He needed to complete his mission before anyone had a chance to notice him.

events.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
events.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

events.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
events.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

events.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
events.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

events.summary: Chandra and Liliana flee out the back of the nightclub.
events.quote: Chandra hopped a guardrail and ducked through the back of the nightclub.

events.summary: The hooded man shows a Leaking Spire symbol to renegade inventors and steals a listener module from an automaton.
events.quote: The little metallic listener module obeyed his commands, prying itself out of her device.

events.summary: The module reveals to the man the conversations and a location for the demonstration.
events.quote: As he walked, he willed it to activate

events.summary: Chandra shows Liliana a worn mosaic of her father Kiran and says her parents were killed when she was a child.
events.quote: They were killed when I was a child.

events.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
events.quote: My parents died because of him.

events.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
events.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

events.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
events.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

events.summary: Chandra and Liliana jump onto the Aradara dawn train to escape.
events.quote: Chandra ran and stepped up, putting her hand in the way as the doors tried to close.

events.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
events.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

events.summary: Chandra burns open the train door and they leap off to reach the disruption.
events.quote: Chandra hot-punched the door handle.

events.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
events.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

events.summary: The man accosts an older woman, pointing a metallic claw hand at her.
events.quote: His right hand, emerging from his sleeve, was a metallic claw

events.summary: The woman with Chandra's auburn hair stuns Chandra, who is shocked.
events.quote: She had auburn hair like Chandra's, but darker

events.summary: Tezzeret calls the woman Renegade Prime and warns her spectacle will not matter to his Fair, but she vows to stop the Head Judge.
events.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

events.summary: Liliana grabs the man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.
events.quote: Tezzeret.

events.summary: Chandra, gaping at the woman with hair like hers, speaks to her as her mother.
events.quote: gaping at the woman with the hair like hers

relations.note: Chandra addresses the Renegade Prime as her mother.
relations.quote: gaping at the woman with the hair like hers

relations.note: Chandra says Baral killed her father in front of her.
relations.quote: Baral had killed her father in front of her.

relations.note: He hunts her for her spectacle against the Fair.
relations.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

relations.note: He calls it his Fair and is addressed as Head Judge.
relations.quote: Do you think your little spectacle is going to matter to my Fair?

relations.note: Liliana accompanies her and urges her toward trouble and revenge.
relations.quote: Could get ourselves into some deeply satisfying trouble.
She uttered a name that Chandra didn't recognize, with a disgust she didn't understand

relations.note: Chandra calls him one of the Consulate.
